page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support external data transfers and storage communication. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The dedicated CPU allocation and high clock frequency of 3.3 GHz offer consistent processing capabilities for workloads that require predictable compute resources. Because it lacks bundled local storage and GPU hardware, the instance provides a cost-efficient profile for workloads that prioritize raw CPU power and memory over local disk I/O or hardware acceleration. This configuration is suitable for general-purpose applications, web serving, and compute-intensive tasks that utilize network-attached storage.
